activities.name: Victoria Falls
activities.note: high water and low water are different sights, not better and worse ones — one is spray and thunder, the other is bare rock and a clear view of the gorge

windows.reason: peak flow, about 500 million litres a minute in April — though the spray can hide the falls from the viewpoints
the lowest flow of the year; on parts of the Zambian side no water falls at all

activities.name: Devil's Pool, Livingstone Island
activities.note: swimming at the lip of the falls is only possible when the river is low enough to be safe

windows.reason: water at its lowest, which is the safest window for the swim
the pool typically opens from mid-September and stays accessible into December

activities.name: Walking safaris in South Luangwa
activities.note: South Luangwa is the birthplace of the walking safari; over 450 bird species are recorded here

windows.reason: the green season — many camps close and some roads become hard to drive, though it is the best stretch of the year for birds as the migrants arrive
the dry months, when the camps are open and the walking safaris run
